schedule.note: Special Commission Meeting, First Budget Hearing (legal ad dated Sept 2)
Workshop 1:30 p.m., regular meeting 6:30 p.m. Last posted 2026 meeting; none in December.

next.pattern: Third Thursday of the month (second Thursday in May), Commission Workshop at 1:30 p.m. and Regular Commission Meeting at 6:30 p.m., David P. Samson Commission Chambers, Government Center, 18070 Collins Avenue. No December meeting. Special, workshop and emergency meetings are posted to the city event calendar.

levers.how: Attend the regular meeting in person at the Samson Commission Chambers; meetings are also streamed on YouTube and SIBTV. Documents and procedure questions go to the City Clerk at 305.792.1703 or cityclerk@sibfl.net.
levers.rules: No time limit, sign-up procedure or speaker eligibility rule is posted on the meetings page, schedule page or event notices.

levers.how: No dedicated public comment email is posted. The city's general contact portal and the clerk's email (cityclerk@sibfl.net) are the posted channels.
Each elected official has a seat email (mayor@sibfl.net, seat1@ through seat4@sibfl.net) and a direct line listed on the Commission page; the shared office line is 305.792.1700.
